mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM public.account WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND system_role = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN'

SELECT count(*) FROM public.account_department_role AS role_assignment JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = role_assignment.account_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = role_assignment.department_id AND department.active WHERE role_assignment.account_id = #{accountId} AND role_assignment.department_id = #{departmentId} AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL
